relationships.subject: Chronic neuropathic pain
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that the expression level of Dnmt3a in PBN significantly decreased 1 week and 4 weeks after SNI surgery when compared with the sham group

relationships.subject: Dnmt3a
relationships.evidence_quote: Overexpression of PBN Dnmt3a rescued the chronic pain mice from developing these behaviors of negative emotion

relationships.subject: Dnmt3a
relationships.evidence_quote: Dnmt3a knockdown increased both the expression of PBN GluA1-pSer831 and synaptic function of AMPA receptors in PBN neurons.

relationships.subject: GluA1-pSer831
relationships.evidence_quote: Overexpression of PBN GluA1 induced anxiety-like behavior in naïve mice

key_findings: Chronic pain lowers PBN Dnmt3a, which de-represses GluA1-pSer831 and AMPA receptor function, driving anxiety-like behavior.
Dnmt3a overexpression or GluA1 knockdown in PBN prevents pain-induced anxiety without altering nociceptive thresholds.
